feat: map shell chrome glyphs from Clarity slots and App files (#180)

* feat: map shell chrome glyphs from Clarity slots and App files

Compile APP_BAR and PERSONAL_CENTER icons from a Clarity slot table
instead of shell-item icon strings. Restore personal-center authoring,
stop Swan from guessing Material names, and add an App file library on
existing Hawk object storage with Robin management and runtime fetch by
id or alias. Studio still accepts the icon field but always writes empty
so old clients can roll back without a column drop.

* feat(robin): upload App files from the file library page

Wire PNG/JPEG uploads through the Hawk files presign/finalize API so
Robin can populate the App file library instead of only listing aliases.
